title: GDS-ParT: Gated Dual-Stream Particle Transformer for jet tagging
description:
GDS-ParT is a PyTorch transformer for jet tagging on the JetClass benchmark. Instead of only adding pairwise kinematics to the attention logits as in the Particle Transformer (ParT), it keeps a particle stream and a pairwise relation stream, aggregates each particle's relations into a summary, and maps the summary to identity-initialised gates (1 + tanh) that rescale the query and key channels before the dot product. The reported v2 configuration combines these gates with a ParT-style pairwise bias and class-attention pooling. With 2.07M parameters and 10 million training jets it reaches 0.8484 test accuracy and 0.9853 macro AUC on a balanced one-million-jet JetClass test subset.

The repository includes a memory-efficient data pipeline, training and ablation scripts, a pipeline check against the official ParT checkpoint, and a technical report with the full mathematics.

Documentation: avinashistoocool.github.io/Gated-Dual-Stream-Particle-Transformer
